meta.name: bracket and bush, solved
meta.note: the same two parts as assembly.json, held by two mates solved together instead of one computed in order. Nothing here says how far in the bush goes: the seat is a face, and where the parts meet is the answer rather than the input

features.note: the bracket's bore is this assembly's bore: growing one grows the other, and `cad interference` is what says whether they still fit

mates.note: the barrel in the bore: two turns of freedom gone, and no offset, so it is still free to slide

and the flange against the outside of the wall, which is what actually stops it. assembly.json had to say seat: 10 -- measured from wherever OCCT keeps the bore's origin -- because one mate cannot hold a part in two ways
